now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
now.step: In episode 4, in a fight in Latvia, Karli knocks Lemar into a pillar, killing him.

proposed: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
At the resettlement camp, Karli throws Lemar against a pillar during a fight, killing him.
changes.evidence: In #4 Karli throws Lemar against a support beam at the Latvian GRC Resettlement Camp in Riga, killing him.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
now.step: In episode 4, the Flag Smashers rob supply depots and bomb a GRC building. Their member Nico dies at John Walker's hands.

proposed.happens_at: The GRC storage facility in Lithuania, which the Flag Smashers raid and bomb in #3; only Nico's death (at Walker's hands, in Riga, #4) happens here, covered by the lead:4 entry

changes.evidence: Ep 3 plot: the Flag Smashers raid a GRC storage facility in Lithuania and Karli blows up the building. Nico is killed by Walker in a Riga street in #4.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
now.step: In episode 4, Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help track the super soldier serum, and Zemo joins him and Sam in hunting the Flag Smashers.

proposed.happens_at: Berlin, where Bucky stages a prison riot so Zemo can escape, in #3 (not #4)

changes.evidence: Ep 3 plot: Bucky and Sam visit the imprisoned Zemo in Berlin and Bucky orchestrates a prison riot to help him escape. In #4 Zemo is already with them in Riga.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
now.step: In episode 5, Ayo's Dora Milaje come for Zemo, beat John Walker in a fight, and later take Zemo to the Raft.

proposed.happens_at: Sokovia, at the memorial, where Bucky hands Zemo to the Dora Milaje in #5; their fight with Walker is in Riga in #4 (proposed separately as a new #4 entry)

changes.evidence: Ep 5 plot: Bucky finds Zemo at a memorial in Sokovia and hands him over to the Dora Milaje. The Dora Milaje's fight with Walker happens at Zemo's Latvian residence in Riga in #4.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
now.step: In episode 4, Named the new Captain America, Walker pushes Sam and Bucky aside. After he takes the serum and Lemar dies, he kills a Flag Smasher with the shield in public.

proposed: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
Walker chases down Nico and kills him with the shield in a public square, in front of a horrified crowd.
changes.evidence: In #4, after Lemar's death, Walker corners Nico in a public street in Riga and kills him with the shield as bystanders watch and record.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
now.step: In episode 5, Torres feeds Sam intel on the Flag Smashers and joins him in the field. Sam leaves his damaged Falcon wingsuit with Torres before taking up the shield.

proposed: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
Sam leaves his broken wingsuit with Torres at the camp and takes the shield with him.
changes.evidence: In #5 Torres arrives at the Latvian GRC Resettlement Camp in Riga after the fight with Walker; Sam leaves, taking the shield and telling Torres to keep the Falcon suit.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
now.step: In episode 5, Walker secretly takes the last vial of serum. After Karli kills Lemar in Riga, he kills a Flag Smasher with the shield in front of a crowd. Sam and Bucky take the shield from him, and he is stripped of the title of Captain America.

proposed: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
Sam and Bucky fight Walker for the shield and take it from him, breaking his arm.
changes.evidence: Ep 5 plot: Sam and Bucky pursue Walker after he kills the Flag Smasher, fight him, and take the shield, breaking his arm. Fandom places this in Riga; the stripping of his title happens later, back in the US.

proposed: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#4
The Dora Milaje come for Zemo at his residence and beat Walker in a fight, and Zemo slips away.
changes.evidence: In #4 Ayo, Nomble and Yama interrupt at Zemo's Latvian residence in Riga, fight Walker, Sam and Bucky, and easily defeat them while Zemo escapes.

now: Aida runs the Framework from an oil platform off the Russian coast.

proposed.happens_at: The Ivanov Oil Platform in the Baltic Sea

changes.evidence: Aida keeps the agents plugged into the Framework at the Ivanov Oil Platform, the Superior's base under a drilling platform in the Baltic Sea (Radcliffe: 'a base under a drilling platform in the Baltic'), not Siberia. The episode's real-world location list names only the Baltic Sea platform.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#43
now.step: In episode 43, Raina becomes a thorny Inhuman with visions and is killed by Jiaying.

proposed.happens_at: Afterlife, the Inhuman refuge in Nepal, where Jiaying kills Raina in #43; Raina's change happens in San Juan in #32

changes.evidence: S.O.S. Part One (#43) is set in Afterlife (Nepal); Raina is killed there by Jiaying. Her transformation came in the Kree City under San Juan in What They Become (#32).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#33
now.step: In episode 33, Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA hunts an alien Obelisk, until Coulson kills him and S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off its leaders.

proposed.happens_at: Whitehall's Obelisk hunt and death (Coulson shoots him) are in San Juan in #32, not #33; in #33 S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off HYDRA's leaders at other locations such as the Bloom Estate Winery

changes.evidence: What They Become (#32): in San Juan, Coulson kills Whitehall from behind with a single shot. Aftershocks (#33): the Assassination of Hydra Leaders takes place away from San Juan.
